verdict.rationale: Trilegal documents a Labour and Employment practice covering compensation and benefits structuring, retention and remuneration models, M&A workforce due diligence, and a CTO exit that protected IP. None of the evidence says the firm prepares hiring paperwork such as offer letters, employment agreements, or invention-assignment and confidentiality agreements. These related employment services are adjacent rather than the capability the story names, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm prepares hiring paperwork — offer letters, employment agreements, and invention-assignment/confidentiality agreements — as part of a documented employment practice
